keep.text: K22-D1: Closing the note editor discards the typed title/content: no note is created (everything else unchanged).
K22-D2: Closing the editor shows the new note in the list but never sends it to the server, so it disappears after a page reload.
K41-D1: Keyword search matches note titles only; notes whose content (but not title) contains the keyword are hidden.
K41-D2: Choosing the Reminders suggested filter from the search panel also keeps notes without the Reminders label visible (unlabeled notes leak into the filtered result).

bookstack.text: B64-D1: Selecting any page entry in a book's page list opens the FIRST page of that list instead of the selected one.
B64-D2: Reopening an existing page's editor (Edit) prefills the title but leaves the body field empty.

scope.keep: REQ-2.2 (create and autosave a note) and REQ-4.1 (search keywords and suggested filters), plus every prerequisite they need: REQ-1.1 workspace with Sidebar navigation (Notes and label entries required; other sidebar entries may be present but simple), REQ-2.8 label assignment from the note editor (label chooser with the default Reminders label and user labels), and REQ-2.1 note listing. Other requirements are out of scope.
scope.bookstack: REQ-6.4 (read a page or reopen its editor) plus every prerequisite it needs while logged out: REQ-1.1 home entry links, REQ-5.1/5.2 browse and open books, REQ-5.3 create book (Name, Description, Tags; save and cancel), REQ-6.1 publish a page (New Page, title, body, save page; it returns to the book, whose page list shows the page), and saving an edited page. Login, shelves, drafts, chapters and the dashboard are out of scope (Login/Shelves links may be present but can be stubs).

families.components: native HTML controls, hand-written CSS, no component library
Element Plus component library (use its inputs, dialogs, buttons, tags, etc. idiomatically)
independently written custom components (no component library); e.g. a rich-text/contenteditable body or custom inputs where natural

notes: Cpilot keeps S0 names for BookStack so that a sealed family has an S0/S1 dual-compliant unit (plan §2.2). Family A keeps S0 as the S0 dev family. Svelte is reserved for formal F.
